verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes a public REST API (zulip.com/api/) with documented endpoints like 'send a message', plus a bot framework and Botserver for building on top of the API, giving AI-native users a documented way to programmatically interact with Zulip. Missing for 10: an official OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt was not found (probes returned 404), and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of API usage quality.
